subject.title: Control UI chat markdown only renders data URI images, not remote https image URLs

question: Should Control UI render remote http/https markdown image URLs directly from chat content, and under what trust policy?
rationale: Current source, tests, docs, and merged hardening intentionally prevent remote browser image fetches, while the requested UX improvement changes that security boundary.

options.title: Keep no-remote default
options.body: Preserve the current same-origin/data/blob image policy and require structured same-origin media, local blobs, a proxy, or an explicit opt-in design before remote images render.

options.title: Allow direct remote images
options.body: Accept the browser-fetch privacy tradeoff and update renderer, sanitizer/CSP expectations, docs, tests, and real browser proof together.

options.title: Fold into inline media design
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/64607 as the broader policy vehicle while keeping this focused issue linked as the remote markdown image slice.

recommendation.title: Keep no-remote default
recommendation.body: Preserve the current same-origin/data/blob image policy and require structured same-origin media, local blobs, a proxy, or an explicit opt-in design before remote images render.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is closest to the Control UI browser-fetch and CSP security policy that drobison00 directly changed in merged history.
